log.text: Stealth Rock up on P1's side

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Blastoise. Lead Grimmsnarl/Garganacl: Prankster support + WideGuard/SaltCure sand counter core. Backs Arcanine-Hisui (Blastoise pivot) + Sableye complete anti-sand plan.
decisions.notebook: Opponent commits sand Hippowdon SmoothRock; Sneasler Unburden early aggression; double Prankster vs Whimsicott key; Arcanine pivot vs Blastoise; sand counter core prepared.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega is Blastoise. Lead Sneasler + Whimsicott to Fake Out or Tailwind, controlling speed against Pelipper rain or Prankster threats. Back Blastoise-Mega and Choice Scarf Kleavor to clean up under rain or pressure through Stone Axe and Water Spout.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Grimmsnarl)
decisions.rationale: Wide Guard blocks potential spreads while Parting Shot drops Sneasler offenses and pivots into sand counter core; Prankster priority secures the drop before Unburden activation.
decisions.notebook: Opponent sand Hippowdon SmoothRock; Sneasler Unburden early aggression; double Prankster vs Whimsicott key; Arcanine pivot vs Blastoise; sand counter core prepared.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out on Grimmsnarl interrupts Prankster support or Sucker Punch pressure, while Whimsicott sets Tailwind to ensure Sneasler and partners outspeed everything for subsequent turns.
decisions.notebook: Grimmsnarl has Prankster, Spirit Break, Sucker Punch, Parting Shot, Reflect. Garganacl has Purifying Salt, Salt Cure, Recover, Stealth Rock, Wide Guard. Pelipper has Drizzle, Hydro Pump, Hurricane, Tailwind, Protect. Basculegion has Swift Swim, Wave Crash, Last Respects, Aqua Jet, Protect.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Grimmsnarl)
decisions.rationale: Prankster Parting Shot drops both offenses before Tailwind sweep; Wide Guard covers any spread follow-up while preserving Garganacl for sand core.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads aggressive Unburden Sneasler + Prankster Whimsicott; prepare Arcanine pivot for Blastoise and sand counter with Hippowdon/Kleavor awareness.

decisions.rationale: Arcanine-Hisui Intimidate + pivot best vs Unburden Sneasler aggression; aligns with notebook plan for Blastoise later.
decisions.notebook: Opponent aggressive Unburden Sneasler + Prankster Whimsicott lead pattern; Arcanine-Hisui as primary pivot vs Blastoise; prepare sand answers for Hippowdon/Kleavor.

decisions.rationale: Under Tailwind, Sneasler outspeeds everything. Sneasler targets Grimmsnarl with Close Combat for massive damage (or KO through sash if weakened/crit), while Whimsicott uses Moonblast on Grimmsnarl to pick it up or deal heavy damage, ignoring Wide Guard.
decisions.notebook: Grimmsnarl has Prankster, Spirit Break, Sucker Punch, Parting Shot, Reflect. Garganacl has Purifying Salt, Salt Cure, Recover, Stealth Rock, Wide Guard.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Arcanine-Hisui)
decisions.rationale: Tailwind lets foes act first; Arcanine at 23% cannot take another SE hit. Protect + Wide Guard blocks immediate threats and preserves pivot for later sand answers.
decisions.notebook: Aggressive Unburden Sneasler + Prankster Whimsicott lead; Arcanine-Hisui primary pivot vs Blastoise; prepare sand answers for Hippowdon/Kleavor.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler's Close Combat cleanly KOs the weakened Arcanine-Hisui through any remaining Leftovers healing. Whimsicott can Moonblast Arcanine-Hisui to guarantee the finish even if Arcanine tries to move or stay in.
ES priority lets Arcanine strike first for chip/KO pressure on sash Sneasler before CC; Salt Cure punishes and sets residual on the fast threat while Garg survives neutral hits.
decisions.notebook: Arcanine-Hisui primary pivot vs Blastoise; prepare sand answers for Hippowdon/Kleavor; aggressive Unburden Sneasler + Prankster Whimsicott lead pattern.

decisions.rationale: Sableye Mental Herb blocks Encore, Prankster Taunt/WoW pressures Sneasler before it moves; Grimmsnarl less safe vs Unburden speed.
decisions.notebook: Sneasler+Whimsicott aggressive lead pattern; prepare sand answers for Hippowdon/Kleavor; Arcanine-Hisui primary Blastoise pivot.

decisions.rationale: Arcanine-Hisui is at 28% and protected last turn, so it cannot safely use Protect again consecutively without heavy failure risk. Sneasler outspeeds everything under Tailwind and can KO Arcanine-Hisui with Close Combat, bypassing any potential Wide Guard from Garganacl. Whimsicott refreshes Tailwind to keep us ahead in speed for the remaining endgame.
Sneasler at 16% with Salt Cure; Taunt stops Protect while repeated Salt Cure pressures the wincon before faster foes act.

Sneasler is at 16% with Salt Cure and lowered defenses; switching Sneasler to Blastoise avoids certain KO and preserves offensive presence. Whimsicott targets Garganacl with Moonblast to pressure it while Sableye is immune/passive.
decisions.notebook: Grimmsnarl: Prankster, Spirit Break, Sucker Punch, Parting Shot, Reflect. Garganacl: Purifying Salt, Salt Cure, Recover, Stealth Rock, Wide Guard. Sableye: Prankster, Taunt, Recover, Foul Play, Will-O-Wisp.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Sableye)
decisions.rationale: Wide Guard blocks Water Spout spread and protects both; Foul Play pressures weakened Whimsicott without giving free turns; Sableye survives Moonblast range at 50%.
decisions.notebook: Sneasler+Whimsicott lead pattern; sand answers needed for Hippowdon/Kleavor; Arcanine-Hisui primary Blastoise pivot; prepare for Blastoise Mega Launcher Water Spout after Taunt ends.

decisions.rationale: Mega Blastoise gains Mega Launcher and speed to threaten Garganacl with Aura Sphere while Whimsicott KOs the weakened Sableye with Moonblast. Spout hits both foes hard if they don't Wide Guard.
decisions.notebook: Grimmsnarl has Prankster, Spirit Break, Sucker Punch, Parting Shot, Reflect. Garganacl has Purifying Salt, Salt Cure, Recover, Stealth Rock, Wide Guard. Sableye has Prankster, Taunt, Recover, Foul Play, Will-O-Wisp, Mental Herb.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Sableye)
decisions.rationale: Sableye 3% dies to any hit; switch preserves it for later while Wide Guard blocks Water Spout and protects both. Grimmsnarl brings Dark/Fairy typing and Prankster utility into endgame vs remaining foes.
decisions.notebook: Sneasler+Whimsicott lead pattern; sand answers needed for Hippowdon/Kleavor; Arcanine-Hisui primary Blastoise pivot; prepare for Blastoise Mega Launcher Water Spout after Taunt ends; Grimmsnarl as late-game Dark/Fairy pivot and Prankster support.

decisions.rationale: Sableye is at 3% HP and easily KO'd by Whimsicott's Moonblast. Blastoise-Mega targets Garganacl with Aura Sphere to deal massive super-effective damage and bypass Wide Guard, preventing another block on Water Spout.
decisions.notebook: Grimmsnarl: Prankster, Spirit Break, Sucker Punch, Parting Shot, Reflect. Garganacl: Purifying Salt, Salt Cure, Recover, Stealth Rock, Wide Guard. Sableye: Prankster, Taunt, Recover, Foul Play, Will-O-Wisp, Mental Herb.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Grimmsnarl)
decisions.rationale: Blastoise faster, likely attacks; Sucker Punch KOs or pressures before Spout; Wide Guard blocks spread again; Salt Cure chips Blastoise; Garganacl survives one hit at 40%.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Garganacl used Wide Guard last turn (turn 7) and may repeat it to block spread Water Spout. Blastoise-Mega can break through with single-target Aura Sphere into Garganacl while Whimsicott targets Grimmsnarl with super-effective Moonblast.
Sableye at 3% must Recover immediately; Grimmsnarl Sucker Punch pressures 10% Blastoise with priority before it can act or spout.

Blastoise is at 10% and afflicted by Salt Cure, meaning it faints at the end of the turn unless it Protects. Whimsicott outspeeds both foes and can KO the 3% Sableye with Moonblast, while Blastoise Protects to survive Sucker Punch/attacks.

Blastoise fainted. Sneasler enters against 17% Grimmsnarl and 8% Sableye; Unburden activates (Focus Sash spent earlier), threatening both with Close Combat / Dire Claw / Fake Out before Prankster status or Sucker Punch. Whimsicott passes.
Sneasler faster and low HP; Sucker Punch priority pressures it while Recover keeps Sableye alive for Prankster follow-up. Avoid free SE Moonblast when recovery available.

Sneasler outspeeds both foes and uses Dire Claw into Grimmsnarl to KO its 17% HP, bypassing Sucker Punch priority. Whimsicott uses Moonblast into Sableye (8% HP) to finish it off. Both foes are very low and weak to these spread/targeted attacks.
decisions.notebook: Grimmsnarl has Sucker Punch and Spirit Break; Sableye has Recover, Foul Play, Will-O-Wisp, Taunt.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Sucker Punch priority outspeeds scarf Kleavor assuming attack; Taunt blocks Whimsicott Tailwind/Encore while both remain faster; low HP precludes Recover or non-priority; Reflect irrelevant vs current threats.

Grimmsnarl has priority Sucker Punch (+1) over Kleavor's Stone Axe / X-Scissor, but Whimsicott outspeeds both foes and can KO the low-HP Sableye with Moonblast. Kleavor uses Stone Axe into Grimmsnarl to break its sash or deal heavy damage, while Whimsicott targets Sableye to eliminate it.
decisions.notebook: Grimmsnarl carries Sucker Punch and Spirit Break. Sableye carries Recover, Foul Play, Will-O-Wisp, Taunt.

decisions.rationale: Sableye slower; only Moonblast possible from Whimsicott; Recover gives survival chance vs possible Stone Axe miss; Prankster status already used.
Sableye is at 12% HP and weak to Fairy (Moonblast KOes). Kleavor is Choice-locked into Stone Axe, which hits Sableye for neutral damage. Double targeting Sableye secures the final KO to win Game 2.

reflections.summary: Lost due to previewing Grimmsnarl/Garganacl/Sableye/Arcanine-Hisui into confirmed Sneasler+Whimsicott lead + Blastoise-Mega; core lacked answers to Moonblast pressure and Kleavor scarf entry after Garganacl fell.
reflections.adjustment: Next game preview a different four with Mega option that directly pressures Whimsicott or walls Blastoise Spout instead of relying on Arcanine-Hisui pivot.
reflections.notebook: Sneasler+Whimsicott lead pattern; Kleavor Choice Scarf confirmed; Blastoise-Mega brought and used; sand answers needed for Hippowdon/Kleavor; prepare for Blastoise Mega Launcher Water Spout after Taunt ends; Grimmsnarl as late-game Dark/Fairy pivot and Prankster support.

reflections.summary: The opponent brought a disruption-heavy core of Grimmsnarl, Garganacl, and Sableye, but Whimsicott and Kleavor managed to clean up the endgame after Blastoise and Sneasler fell, converting the win despite a difficult matchup against Prankster utility.
reflections.adjustment: Retain fast offensive pressure against stall-oriented Prankster cores, but ensure defensive positioning prevents Sneasler and Blastoise from getting whittled down too early by priority attacks.
reflections.notebook: Grimmsnarl carries Sucker Punch and Spirit Break. Sableye carries Recover, Foul Play, Will-O-Wisp, Taunt, and Mental Herb. Garganacl carries Wide Guard, Salt Cure, Recover, and Stealth Rock. Arcanine-Hisui carries Extreme Speed, Rock Slide, Will-O-Wisp, and Protect.
